tasks.label: 📦 Build: With Registry Cache & Push (Optimized)
tasks.command: echo '=== Building with registry cache (--cache-layers + zstd + retry) ==='; echo "Recipe: ${input:recipeFile}"; echo "Registry: ${input:registryEndpoint}"; bluebuild build ${input:recipeFile} --platform linux/amd64 --skip-validation --push --registry ${input:registryEndpoint} --cache-layers --compression-format zstd --retry-push; echo '✅ Build + push + cache complete'

tasks.label: 📦 Build: Verify Architecture
tasks.command: echo '--- Image Listing ---'; docker images localhost/bazzite-moonlight; echo ''; echo '--- Architecture Check ---'; ARCH=$(docker inspect localhost/bazzite-moonlight:latest --format '{{.Architecture}}'); echo "Detected: ${ARCH}"; if [ "${ARCH}" = "amd64" ]; then echo '✅ Architecture is amd64 (correct for x86_64 target)'; else echo '❌ WARNING: Expected amd64 but got '${ARCH}' — rebuild with --platform linux/amd64'; fi

tasks.label: 🔄 Build Pipeline: Optimized with Cache (Build + Push + Verify)
📦 Push: Tag Image for Registry
tasks.command: ENDPOINT='${input:registryEndpoint}'; TAG='${input:imageTag}'; echo "Tagging localhost/bazzite-moonlight:latest → ${ENDPOINT}/bazzite-moonlight:${TAG}"; docker tag localhost/bazzite-moonlight:latest ${ENDPOINT}/bazzite-moonlight:${TAG}; echo '✅ Tagged successfully'

tasks.label: 📦 Push: Image to Registry
tasks.command: ENDPOINT='${input:registryEndpoint}'; TAG='${input:imageTag}'; echo "Pushing ${ENDPOINT}/bazzite-moonlight:${TAG} ..."; docker push ${ENDPOINT}/bazzite-moonlight:${TAG}; echo '✅ Push complete'

tasks.label: 🚀 Deploy: Optimized Build & Push to Registry
🚀 Deploy: Push Existing Image to Registry
🚀 Deploy: Tarball via SSH (Strategy A)
tasks.command: echo 'Saving and transferring image to bazzite.local.keithmarcus.com ...'; docker save localhost/bazzite-moonlight:latest | ssh bazzite.local.keithmarcus.com sudo podman load; echo '✅ Transfer complete — now rebase on the VM with:'; echo '  rpm-ostree rebase ostree-unverified-image:containers-storage:localhost/bazzite-moonlight:latest'; echo '  systemctl reboot'

tasks.label: 🧪 Experiment: Thin Overlay Build & Push
tasks.command: echo '=== Thin overlay experiment build ==='; bluebuild build recipes/recipe-experiment.yml --platform linux/amd64 --skip-validation --push --registry ${input:registryEndpoint} --cache-layers --compression-format zstd --retry-push; echo '✅ Experiment image built and pushed'; echo '➡️  On VM, rebase with:'; echo "  rpm-ostree rebase ostree-unverified-image:registry:${input:registryEndpoint}/bazzite-moonlight-experiment:latest"; echo '  systemctl reboot'

tasks.label: 🔀 Git: Push bazzite-moonlight Subtree Changes
tasks.command: echo 'Pushing subtree changes from homelab → standalone bazzite-moonlight repo ...'; cd /Users/digitsolu/dev/homelab && git subtree push --prefix=common/ublue/bazzite-moonlight bazzite-moonlight main; echo '✅ Subtree push complete'

tasks.label: 🔀 Git: Push Dotfiles Subtree Changes
tasks.command: echo 'Pushing dotfiles subtree changes from homelab → standalone dotfiles repo ...'; cd /Users/digitsolu/dev/homelab && git subtree push --prefix=common/ublue/bazzite-moonlight/dotfiles dotfiles main; echo '✅ Dotfiles subtree push complete'

tasks.label: 🔀 Git: Pull Dotfiles Subtree Updates
tasks.command: echo 'Pulling latest dotfiles from standalone repo into homelab subtree ...'; cd /Users/digitsolu/dev/homelab && git subtree pull --prefix=common/ublue/bazzite-moonlight/dotfiles dotfiles main; echo '✅ Dotfiles subtree pull complete'

tasks.label: 🔀 Git: Pull BlueBuild Modules Updates
tasks.command: cd /Users/digitsolu/dev/homelab && echo 'Fetching latest bluebuild-modules ...' && git fetch bluebuild-modules main && echo 'Checking out remote branch for split ...' && git checkout -b bb-temp bluebuild-modules/main && echo 'Splitting module subtree ...' && git subtree split --prefix="modules/default-flatpaks" -b bb-split && echo 'Returning to main ...' && git checkout main && echo 'Pulling subtree update ...' && git subtree pull --prefix="common/ublue/bazzite-moonlight/modules/default-flatpaks" bb-split && echo 'Cleaning up temp branches ...' && git branch -D bb-temp bb-split && echo '✅ BlueBuild modules updated'

tasks.label: 🔀 Git: Commit and Push All Subtrees
🧹 Clean: Prune Colima Docker Storage
tasks.command: echo 'Pruning unused docker data in colima ...'; docker system prune -a --volumes; echo '✅ Prune complete'

tasks.label: 🧪 Test: Cross-Arch Emulation Check
tasks.command: echo 'Testing x86_64 emulation in colima ...'; RESULT=$(docker run --rm --platform linux/amd64 alpine uname -m 2>&1); if [ "${RESULT}" = "x86_64" ]; then echo '✅ Cross-arch emulation working (output: '${RESULT}')'; else echo '❌ Emulation FAILED (output: '${RESULT}') — ensure colima has rosetta: true and binfmt: true'; fi
